status: Post-hoc analysis of frozen A/B results; not a retroactive preregistration
focal_estimand: Mean paired M6-M3 OOD accuracy difference in percentage points, separately for each budget; OOD is the equal mean of Yelp and Amazon
inference_unit: One paired training seed, conditional on the source pool and test domains; n=5
interval: Approximate 95% paired-t interval, unadjusted; normality of five differences cannot be established reliably
sensitivity: Exact two-sided paired sign-flip test, all 32 assignments; minimum possible p is 0.0625. Both this and t-test outputs are reported, not cherry-picked
multiplicity: Holm separately over 3 focal OOD comparisons and 69 secondary comparisons; intervals are explicitly unadjusted
bootstrap: 10000 replicates; fixed domain and label proportions; shared example resampling across all five seeds; conditional fixed-model and crossed seed/example intervals reported separately; exploratory small-n sensitivity
calibration: Brier, clipped binary NLL (1e-12), top-label ECE with 15 equal-width confidence bins; descriptive only, no calibration fitting
cases: M6 vs M3, all 3 budgets and 3 domains, seed 13, all four correctness-transition categories; one smallest SHA256(C-v1-case|example_id) per category. No case cherry-picking after reading text
strata: True-label class; token lengths <=128, 129-512, >512 including special tokens; regex negation markers. Descriptive, not causal or gold linguistic annotations
cost: Separate selected training, incremental search and standalone search. M6/L2SP include inherited M3 search in standalone cost; M4 includes inherited M1 search. Keep successful-invocation timing caveat and diagnostic-teacher memory caveat

cka.status: SUPERSEDED before real execution by C-handoff-v2.json; keep original analysis plan for provenance
cka.jobs: One seed per job (6 models); optional seed-13/budget-400 smoke job first
cka.inputs: 256 fixed balanced test examples per domain (128 per class); sorted SHA256(SC4001-C-v1-20261110|example_id) within class; same IDs for every model and seed
pooling: mean over all non-padding tokens, including special tokens
cka.layers: Embedding layer 0 and encoder layers 1-12; degenerate constant CLS embeddings are NA
cka.checks: Data metadata hashes, model/config/selection agreement, checkpoint SHA256, fixed sample manifest, max archived-probability replay discrepancy <=1e-4
cka.precision: FP32 inference, eval mode, no TF32; float64 CPU similarity calculations
cka.outputs: Small CSV/JSON and execution log only. No saved weights or hidden activations
cka.interpretation: Descriptive representation similarity, not proof of semantic preservation or causality
